title: Maybank Marathon 2026 Review: What the 15th Edition Was Like
meta_description: Maybank Marathon 2026 review: 14,100 runners from 46 countries at Bali United Training Center on 23 August, Kenyan wins, and a two-day format planned for 2027.
dek: Indonesia's first World Athletics Elite Label road race held its 15th edition in Gianyar, Bali, on 23 August 2026. Here is what it was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Maybank Marathon is Bali's international marathon. The 15th edition, on Sunday 23 August 2026, drew 14,100 runners from 46 countries to Bali United Training Center in Gianyar [1]. It is Indonesia's first road race with a World Athletics Elite Label [1], and the front of the race showed it: Kenya's Michael Kimani Kamau won in 2:16:10 and Veronicah Njeri Maina in 2:37:22 [1]. The organisers highlighted the course, medical and safety preparation, and CPR training for pacers [1], and they are considering a two-day format for 2027 [1]. If you want an international marathon field and a race in Bali, this is it.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 15th Maybank Marathon was run on Sunday 23 August 2026 from Bali United Training Center (BUTC) in Gianyar regency, under the theme Pace You Forward [1]. 14,100 runners from 46 countries took part across the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and wheelchair categories [1].
The race started in the early hours, with thousands of runners at the start line before dawn [1]. Maybank Indonesia said the event ran safely and in an orderly way [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Kenyans won the open marathons: Michael Kimani Kamau in 2:16:10 and Veronicah Njeri Maina in 2:37:22, each taking Rp260 million [1]. In the national division, Robi Syianturi won the men's race in 2:28:30 and Ina Lydia the women's in 3:09:55, each taking Rp100 million [1]. Total prize money was more than Rp3 billion [1].
With prize money on that scale and an Elite Label, the race attracts an international elite field. For most runners, that mainly means a fast front pack to watch.

sections.heading: Preparation, and What Changes Next
paragraphs: Maybank said the 15th edition was built on course, medical and safety preparation, a training programme in six cities, and CPR training for pacers [1].

Project director Bambang Irawan said the 2027 race may run over two days after a review of the format, to spread the benefit to Bali more widely [1]. If that happens, check which day your distance falls on before booking travel.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big international marathon in Southeast Asia with a strong elite field and a holiday attached. It has the scale, the label and the prize money, and 15 editions of experience.
Treat it as a tropical marathon. Late August in Bali is dry season, but a marathon in Gianyar is still hot and humid, so pace for conditions, not for the elite times.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Maybank Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 14,100 runners from 46 countries took part in the 15th edition on Sunday 23 August 2026, at Bali United Training Center in Gianyar, Bali. Categories were the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and a wheelchair race.

faqs.question: Who won the Maybank Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Kenya's Michael Kimani Kamau won the men's open marathon in 2:16:10 and Veronicah Njeri Maina the women's in 2:37:22. In the national division, Robi Syianturi won in 2:28:30 and Ina Lydia in 3:09:55. Open winners received Rp260 million each.

faqs.question: Will the Maybank Marathon become a two-day event?
faqs.answer: Possibly. After the 2026 race, project director Bambang Irawan said the 2027 edition could be held over two days following a review of the format, to spread the event's benefits more widely in Bali.
